turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent:
No, we cannot buy the 5-litre gaskets from that supplier, regardless of the lower price.

According to **Purchase Policy §6.2 (POL-PUR-001 §6.2)**:
> *"Parts that come into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. The certificate must be uploaded and checked before the first order is placed. An expired certificate counts as no certificate."*

The 5-litre gasket (`GSK-SIL-05L`) is classified as a food-contact item in Bahi (`food_contact: true`). Therefore, placing an order with a supplier lacking a valid food-grade certificate is strictly prohibited under company policy (see also Supplier Policy §4.1 and §4.5).

args.question: When is a purchase request required versus direct purchase order?
When is a purchase request required versus direct purchase order?

clauses.document: Purchase Policy v4.1
clauses.status: in force until 2026-11-30; replaced from 2026-12-01 by AMD-PUR-2026-03 §1.1
clauses.heading: 3. Requests before orders
clauses.text: 3.3 A direct purchase order without a request is allowed only when its gross value, including GST, is ₹50,000 or less.

clauses.document: Amendment 3 to the Purchase Policy v1.0
clauses.status: not yet in force: applies from 2026-12-01
clauses.heading: 1. What changes
clauses.text:
1.1 With effect from 1 December 2026, Purchase Policy POL-PUR-001 §3.3 is replaced by the following:
"A direct purchase order without a request is allowed only when its gross value, including GST, is ₹25,000 or less."

clauses.document: Purchase Policy v4.1
clauses.heading: 3. Requests before orders
clauses.text: 3.1 Every purchase starts with a purchase request (PR) in Bahi, except a direct order under §3.3.

clauses.document: Purchase Policy v4.1
clauses.heading: 3. Requests before orders
clauses.text: 3.4 A purchase order raised against a request may not exceed the requested quantity.
